items.headline: adidas makes the case for a square-toed Forum
items.caption: The Forum SQ Trainer gives the 1984 basketball shoe a cubist reshape.
body: The Forum barely changed in 40 years, until this.
Clean white makes the odd shape work.
How to wear it: with wide trousers that show the toe.

items.headline: Brain Dead turns an adidas climbing shoe into an oddball
items.caption: The collab starts with a real Five Ten NIAD climbing shoe.
body: It makes no apologies for its strange shape.
Not gorpcore cosplay: an actual climbing shoe.
How to wear it: with cropped cargos.

items.headline: Nike's GORE-TEX Air Max 95 wants to retire your boots
items.caption: The Big Bubble Air Max 95 gets waterproofing for winter.
body: Nike keeps giving classics the GORE-TEX treatment.
Wear the sneaker you want, even in slush.
How to wear it: with a puffer and dark denim.

items.headline: Eugene Whang and nonnative make clothes with 'Feeling'
items.caption: The designer-DJ and nonnative's founder on their collab line.
body: Great clothes, like great songs, are a vibe.
Takayuki Fujii co-leads the line.
How to wear it: relaxed layers, good headphones.

items.headline: GTA 6's fake Nikes go way beyond Air Force 1s
items.caption: Rockstar's 'Eris' brand is a cheeky Nike parody.
body: Even the name is a joke on Nike's Greek-goddess roots.
Sneaker stores fill the game's map.
Style lesson: even games know a good trainer.

items.headline: Hunger Games star Joseph Zada gets premiere-ready
items.caption: The 21-year-old Australian actor on his New York premiere day.
body: His film Sunrise on the Reaping is out this week.
He's still getting used to fame.
Style lesson: confidence is the best accessory.

items.headline: Inside GQ's Men of the Year party under Waterloo
items.caption: A 60-metre red carpet ran through the graffiti-covered Leake Street Arches.
body: Guests couldn't get enough of each other.
Best fits, stories and late-night antics.
Style lesson: party looks should move.

items.headline: Has Zegna cracked modern tailoring?
items.caption: Its new Falcon jacket adds sporty utility to mix-and-match clothes.
body: Artistic director Alessandro Sartori explains the idea.
Tailoring, but easier to live in.
How to wear it: over a knit, with smart trousers.

items.headline: The first Esquire Watch Awards
items.caption: Twelve categories, from record slimness to cultural impact.
body: Winners include big names and independents.
Innovation and design both count.
Style lesson: buy a watch with a story.

items.headline: Ralph Lauren's Holiday Experience comes to Sydney
items.caption: A 10-metre Christmas tree goes up at The Rocks.
body: Runs 21–29 November at First Fleet Park.
Workshops and gifting included.
Style lesson: festive can still be classic.

items.headline: Oris makes a Doraemon watch
items.caption: The famous robot cat comes to Oris' home in Holstein.
body: A limited edition.
Playful but still Swiss.
Style lesson: one fun watch is allowed.

items.headline: All the new indie watches from IAMWATCH 2026
items.caption: Singapore's indie-focused fair brought a pile of new releases.
body: Small brands, big ideas.
Hodinkee rounds them up.
Style lesson: independents offer value and character.

items.headline: Checking on a 'loud' neighbour raises $109,000 for her
items.caption: Strangers rallied around an 87-year-old woman with Parkinson's.
body: She had lived alone with little help.
One knock on the door changed everything.

items.headline: Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth
items.caption: The Empire State Building glowed gold to mark the milestone.
body: A signal now takes 24 hours to reach home.
Gold nods to Voyager's golden record.

items.headline: Over 100 cave bear skeletons found in the Alps
items.caption: A mountain guide discovered the cave in Italy's South Tyrol.
body: It was kept secret to stop looting.
Scientists will study it after the spring thaw.
